newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $1.5 bln for Oct 31.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $1.5 bln for Oct 31.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $1.54 billion in 26 offerings for Thursday, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $137 million in 12 offerings, with a $79 million Mississippi general obligation offering at 1100 EST the largest deal.
Negotiated sales total $1.4 billion in 14 offerings. The largest issue is a $775 million taxable New York State Dormitory Authority through Lehman Brothers.
An additional two negotiated deals totaling $16 million are on Reuter's possible calendar for Thursday, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues depending on market conditions.
